title: Practical Creativity
summary: Raph Koster's 2014 GDC Next talk on what science says about creativity, with practical steps game designers and developers can use to be more creative. It frames creativity as applying existing patterns in new contexts.
why: Recommended even to people outside game development as a useful, practical perspective on how creativity works.

quote.text: I recommend his 2014 GDC talk, "Practical Creativity" [1], even to developers who are not interested in game development.
